title: Negation invariance of assignment weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of the states “free,” “fixed to $1$,” or “fixed to $-1$.” Exchanging the two fixed states in every coordinate leaves the product weight unchanged, where the coordinate weights are $ rac12$ for a free state and $ rac14$ for either fixed state.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
